hooks.name: Lint on Save
hooks.description: Run ESLint on JS/JSX/CSS file saves to catch common mistakes early

action.command: cd cloudguard && npx eslint --no-eslintrc -c '{"env":{"browser":true,"es2021":true},"parserOptions":{"ecmaVersion":"latest","sourceType":"module","ecmaFeatures":{"jsx":true}},"rules":{"no-unused-vars":"warn","no-undef":"warn"}}' --ext .js,.jsx src/ 2>&1 | head -40
